meta.description: SMTP throughput baselines for the ApexMail MTA (Message Transfer Agent). Values represent outbound email delivery throughput measured from dedicated MTA instances.
meta.environment: hetzner-cx42 (4 vCPU, 16 GB RAM) — dedicated MTA node, 1 Gbps network

smtp_messages_per_second.description: Number of SMTP messages successfully delivered per second per MTA instance. Includes successful deliveries only (2xx SMTP responses).

smtp_connections.description: Number of concurrent SMTP connections maintained per MTA instance. Each connection corresponds to an open TCP socket to a receiving mail server.

smtp_connection_setup_time.description: Time to establish a new SMTP connection (TCP handshake + SMTP greeting + STARTTLS negotiation). Measured at the 95th percentile to exclude slow-responding remote servers.

smtp_delivery_per_connection.description: Average number of messages delivered per SMTP connection. Higher values indicate better connection reuse (pipelining) and fewer per-message overheads.

smtp_error_rate.description: Percentage of SMTP delivery attempts that resulted in a non-2xx response (temporary or permanent failure).

smtp_throughput_per_domain.description: Maximum sustained throughput to a single destination domain (e.g., gmail.com, outlook.com). Limited by remote MTA rate limiting and connection throttling.
